explanation: The repository-local Claude SEO skill suite is removed: .agents/skills/seo*, vendor/claude-seo, seo-skills.lock.json, scripts/seo_skills.py, scripts/seo_runtime.py, tests/seo_skills and docs/seo-tooling.md. AGENTS.md loses its SEO skills section, the catalog drops the vendor directory, and .gitattributes, .gitignore, knip, CodeQL and public-safety allowances no longer name those paths. SEO.md, PROJECT_GUIDANCE.md, DEVELOPMENT.md and CHANGELOG.md record the removal of the /topics/ guides. No scientific inputs or outputs change. From main: scripts/fetch_data.mts can restore the pinned data release while hypoexplorer-data is private, resolving each pinned release-asset URL through the GitHub releases API when GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN or a gh login is available; SHA-256 pins and the files written are unchanged, and README.md and DEVELOPMENT.md say the restore needs repository access until publication.
